search_keyword: dual momentum absolute momentum with trend filter drawdown control crypto backtest
page_summary: GitHub README for a cross-sectional crypto momentum backtest. Key finding: adding a 200-day BTC trend filter (only deploy capital when BTC>200d MA) roughly halves max drawdown (v1 -89.8% vs v2 -53.8%) versus unfiltered momentum, at the cost of some return/Sharpe. Naive momentum itself underperforms buy-and-hold.
notes: Directly actionable: use a long-term (200d) SMA trend filter as an AND-gate on top of a shorter momentum signal to address the MDD failures of prior BTC momentum attempts (2026-09-03-002, -003).
